content: drizzle-orm v0.45.2 is a TypeScript ORM with full SQLite support via better-sqlite3. Import from drizzle-orm/better-sqlite3. Schema defined in TypeScript (type-safe). drizzle-kit handles migrations. Pitfall: better-sqlite3 is single-connection synchronous, fine for local single-user apps but not serverless. Install: npm i drizzle-orm better-sqlite3; npm i -D drizzle-kit @types/better-sqlite3
